scene.ko: 마트 계산대에서 적립 회원으로 가입해 할인받고, 가져온 장바구니를 쓰고 휴대폰으로 결제한다.

lines.en: Hi there. Do you have a rewards card with us?
No, I don't. Is it free to sign up?
alt: No. Does it cost anything to join?
I don't. Is it free to join?

lines.en: Yes, you just need a phone number. You'd save $4.50 on your groceries today.
lines.ko: 네, 전화번호만 있으면 돼요. 오늘 사시는 것에서 4달러 50센트가 할인돼요.

lines.en: Oh, then I'll sign up. Do I just type my number in here?
lines.ko: 아, 그럼 가입할게요. 여기에 번호만 입력하면 되나요?
alt: Then sure, let's do it. Should I enter my number here?
Great, I'll sign up. Do I put my number in on this screen?

lines.en: Yes, right there... Okay, you're all set. Do you need any bags? They're 10 cents each.
lines.ko: 네, 거기요... 자, 다 됐습니다. 봉투 필요하세요? 하나에 10센트예요.

lines.en: No, thanks. I brought my own bags.
alt: No, I'm fine. I have my own bags.
No thanks, I brought some bags.

lines.en: Perfect. Your total is $36.80. How would you like to pay?
Can I pay with my phone? And could I get the receipt by email?
lines.ko: 휴대폰으로 결제해도 되나요? 그리고 영수증은 이메일로 받을 수 있을까요?
alt: Is it okay to pay with my phone? And can you email me the receipt?
I'll pay with my phone. Could you send the receipt by email?

lines.en: Sure. Just hold your phone near the reader. Then you can type your email on the screen.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 휴대폰을 단말기 가까이에 대 주세요. 그다음 화면에 이메일을 입력하시면 돼요.

expressions.en: Is it free to sign up?

expressions.note: 준비 · 처리가 끝났을 때 직원이 하는 말
봉투 값을 아낄 때 · own = 내 것
with my phone · with a card · 현금은 in cash
